name: TN Hits Century FMC Ooty 2025
information: #### We are proud to announce that this marks Tamil Nadu's 100th official WCA Competition !! Thank you all for the support !! ### THIS IS A FMC ONLY COMPETITION: * Ensure your availability at the venue before the check-in starts at 10:30 AM and the last attempt ends at 4:00 PM. * Food and accommodation is not included in the registration fees. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well. * The competitors have to strictly adhere to the safety guidelines of the Villa.
